title: TC testPointer conditional-by-status coverage
purpose: Prove the 0.5.0 rule: testPointer is required for passing/failing TCs and optional for pending/skipped TCs.

testCases.description: Passing TC carries the executable pointer.
Failing TC still points at the executable that produced the verdict.
Pending TC has no landed executable yet, so no pointer.
Skipped TC also has no executable to point at.
A pending TC may still declare its intended pointer.
